final: SELECT s.zoneref, si.phasefactor, AVG(s.scancount) as avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) as avg_pressratio FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount > 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.phasefactor ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(s.pressratio) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG(s.pressratio) DESC LIMIT 10
